today_summary: GCM26 marks $4,190.5 on the 10-13 snapshot, -$25.7 (-0.61%) and a full give-back of the prior session's break above $4,187 — price closed the week sitting exactly on the shelf it cleared. Local net GEX inside +/-$200 re-deepened to -192.4 (call +219.3 against put -411.7) from -113.5, surrendering two-thirds of Monday's gamma repair in one session. Chain stays structurally call-heavy at 0.39 P/C OI with the call wall at $5,000 (12,002 OI) and the put wall at $3,500 (6,312 OI), both unmoved for five sessions. ATM IV 20.40% puts the 1-sigma daily move at $53.85 (1.29%), and total traded volume collapsed to 5,207 contracts, a 5-day low and -62% from Monday.
five_day_thesis: Five sessions have produced a complete round trip and net nothing: spot $4,187.0 to $4,190.5 (+$3.5, +0.08%) after traversing $4,140.6 low and $4,216.2 high, a $75.6 (1.8%) box that still contains every print. The gamma story round-tripped with it — local net GEX ran -218.8 to -257.5 to -113.5 and back to -192.4, and the flip strike walked $4,800 to $4,750 and returned to $4,800, so the short-gamma pocket is the same depth it was a week ago rather than the halved cushion Monday advertised. Total chain GEX is the one genuine improvement, +$47.9 to 365.8 (+15.1%), built on call OI growing +7,293 (+3.0%) against put OI +2,159 (+2.3%) — dealers are longer gamma in the tails while still short it at the money. ATM IV has gone nowhere at all, 20.45% to 20.40% (-0.05pp) inside a 20.29-20.76% five-day band, which is the tightest vol regime of the cycle and the reason the $75.6 price box has held. The tell this session is participation, not price: 5,207 contracts against a 10,393-13,618 range the prior four days, with P/C volume at a 5-day low 0.308 and the day's flow concentrated in lottery-ticket upside — 612 lots at $6,500, 582 at $7,000, 270 at $7,500 — not at the money where the $4,187 decision actually sits.

prediction: Bias neutral and range-bound while $4,187 remains the decider, with the 1-sigma envelope $4,136.7-$4,244.4 covering nearly the entire five-day box. Upside needs a reclaim of $4,220 to re-target $4,300 (1,956 call OI) and then $4,350, where net GEX first turns durably positive (+5.8 into +17.6 at $4,400) and the recomputed near-field max pain also sits — the $5,500 headline max pain is a legacy-call artifact 31% overhead and exerts no pinning force at 43 DTE. Loss of $4,150 opens the lower shelves at $4,100 (2,299 put OI) and $4,050 (2,475 OI) toward the $4,000 wall (4,319 OI), and with net GEX -192.4 those breaks extend rather than revert.
